ITEM 1 | Small round green vegetable halves/whole, pale-to-medium green with slightly bumpy, leafy surface, about 3 cm across, several pieces scattered on the left and center of the plate, matte with light moisture, some with a slightly charred or darker brown edge | 45
ITEM 2 | Dark reddish-purple to near-black smooth oval beans/berries, glossy skin, about 2 cm long, firm and whole, roughly 15 pieces scattered across the center and right of the plate | 55
ITEM 3 | Pale green crisp celery-like stalks, cut into curved strips about 5 to 7 cm long and 1 cm wide, translucent edges, slightly glossy and moist, clustered on the right side of the plate | 40
